content.title: Study Abroad at Troy University, USA
content.text: Key factsInternational students1000Study abroad at Troy UniversityTroy University is a trailblazing public university headquartered in Troy, a lovely city in the US state of Alabama. It was founded in 1887 and has three other campuses in Phenix City, Montgomery, and Dothan. There’s a variety of courses to choose from, there's everything from accounting to music. The University’s expert staff will prepare you to succeed in the real world - graduates are poised to make their mark on the global community. Whether you plan to study on campus, online, or choose a hybrid format, Troy University gives you the flexibility, resources, and top-notch academic training you'll need to Lead Change in today’s international marketplace. Why study at Troy University Small classes Gain attention from experienced professors with open-door policies Talented staff Learn from highly experienced academics Popular location The USA is the world’s top study abroad destination LocationTroy University600 University Ave, Troy, AL 36082, USATroy is an amazingly authentic American city. It’s packed with plenty of things to see and discover. International students are surrounded by a great number of shops, restaurants, parks, social venues, and lots more. ProgramsFind and apply to programs at Troy UniversitySimply tell us what you're looking for and we'll show you programs that are right for you.Quickly compare programs with StudeeFind ideal programs in secondsExplore exciting alternatives that match your goalsFilter your results to discover perfect courses fasterFees and funding FundingUndergraduate Scholarships: International Education Scholarship - **Amount:** This scholarship will provide the student between $9,300 and $14,000 annually (two semesters). - **Requirements:** Scholarship for new undergraduate students who have elevated academic achievement and will be enrolled full-time in academic courses (minimum of 12 hours per semester). This scholarship is for one year only (two semesters) and will waive up to out-of-state tuition requirements. Students must meet all admission requirements and meet English proficiency requirements. International Honors Scholarship - **Amount:** This scholarship will provide the student between $9,300 and $14,000 annually (two semesters). - **Requirements:** Recognizes undergraduate students who have performed well in their first two semesters at Troy University by maintaining at least a 3.0 Cumulative Institutional GPA. The scholarship will waive up to out-of-state tuition as long as a Cumulative Institutional GPA of at least 3.0 is maintained continually until graduation. International Trojan Opportunity - **Amount:** This scholarship will provide the student between $9,300 and $14,000 annually (two semesters). - **Requirements:** The International Trojan Opportunity scholarship enables students who begin their undergraduate academic work with Troy University at an overseas TROY location to be eligible for an International Trojan Opportunity scholarship if they transition to an Alabama campus as unconditionally admitted students. This scholarship will waive out-of-state tuition requirements. Graduate Scholarships: Graduate Scholarships - **Amount:** This scholarship will provide the student between $8,500 and $9,000 annually (two semesters). - **Requirements:** This scholarship is designed to encourage students from outside of Alabama to pursue graduate work at Troy’s Alabama campuses. Recipients must be “unconditionally” admitted to the graduate school including English proficiency requirements. The scholarship will waive out-of-state tuition. Students must maintain a 3.10 cumulative grade point average at the time of scholarship renewal to continue to receive the scholarship and must enroll in a minimum of nine hours per semester or six hours per term. Graduate Assistantship - **Amount:** Each student receives payments from their specific academic department, plus a tuition waiver of $2,500 per semester. - **Requirements:** These assistantships enable eligible graduate students to receive financial support in exchange for working twenty hours per week in an academic department. These Assistantships are extremely competitive and are awarded by departments throughout the University.Fee information Undergraduate tuition $22,050 per year Graduate tuition $17,100 per year Visa requirements for Troy UniversityMany international students will require a visa to study in the US, and this is a vital step of your study abroad journey. Make sure you understand the requirements you may need to meet before applying.Life at Troy UniversityThe campus is truly global - over 60 nations and 75 languages are represented. You’ll have the chance to make lots of friends from different countries, backgrounds, cultures, and faiths - it’s an amazing place to be. Student-friendly accommodation is widely available at Troy University. There are a number of outstanding residences on campus to choose from. Conveniently located private housing is also easy to find. There’s so much for international students to get involved in outside the classroom at Troy University. Overseas students can make lots of new friends thanks to the many student clubs, organizations, and events. They encourage the international students and the American students to be involved with each other. Not only that, the facilities provided are great such as a free food pantry, and links for students to adapt better in a different country and also information on social events that happens around the university. Alejandra Gutierrez FuenteStudied Mathematics at Troy UniversityAcademic4University social5Accommodation4University facilities4Tell us about Troy UniversityThe facilities are not only very well maintained but are also quite close to each other. The campus is big but you can walk and easily get to the places. Since we are international students, we don't have a car and it's good that you can walk to the places. There is a bus that takes you to Walmart to buy groceries regularly. The bedrooms are clean and big, and the people are usually quite respectful. In addition, the university organizes fun and entertaining social events that you can attend for free.
